svg.title: Ma boîte à outils
svg.desc: Clavier isométrique animé des outils de Nicolas. Au quotidien : Figma, Framer, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Vercel, Claude, ChatGPT. DESIGN : Figma, Framer, Webflow, Canva, Shopify, Affinity, Blender, DaVinci Resolve, Notion, Apple. FRONT : Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS, GSAP, Three.js, Vite, Swift. BACK : Supabase, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Vercel, Docker, Node.js, Bun, Cloudflare, Hostinger, Nginx, Ubuntu. IA & OUTILS : Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Git, GitHub, Python, Rust, macOS.
